mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_records) AS totalDefenses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_records WHERE status = 'completed') AS completedDefenses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_records WHERE status = 'pending') AS pendingDefenses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_topics) AS totalTopics, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'student') AS totalStudents, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 1) FROM defense_records WHERE score IS NOT NULL) AS avgScore

SELECT t.topic_id AS topicId, t.topic_name AS topicName, COUNT(r.defense_id) AS defenseCount FROM defense_topics t LEFT JOIN defense_records r ON r.topic_id = t.topic_id GROUP BY t.topic_id, t.topic_name ORDER BY defenseCount DESC, t.topic_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM defense_records WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC
